en: Black-and-white postcard showing the interior of a modernist, curved panoramic lounge with large floor-to-ceiling windows and abundant indoor plants in planters along the glass. Upholstered chairs line the windows, suggesting a café or espresso bar inside a tall building. The reverse side has standard postcard layout and printed multilingual caption information.
